integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, one continuous take. There is no writing anywhere in the picture. Night, inside a parked car, rain running down the windscreen. {char} sits behind the wheel in a grey hoodie, lit by the warm glow of the dashboard. A slow push-in from the passenger seat. {char} (S1) turns to the camera and says quietly: <d>[English] I kept the letter.</d>

overall_soundscape: Rain drumming on the roof, the soft tick of the indicator. The voice is close and natural.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
reference:
subject_definitions: <Subject 1> is the woman in <Picture 1>: a woman in her thirties.

retention_analysis: <Picture 1>: identity - keep the face and hair exactly; the clothes and the place follow the description.

detailed_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, one continuous take. There is no writing anywhere in the picture. Night, a bus stop in the rain, wet pavement shining under a streetlight. <Subject 1> waits under the shelter in a yellow raincoat, medium shot. <Subject 1> pulls her hood up, then leans out and looks up the road for the bus.

overall_soundscape: Steady rain on the shelter roof, a car hissing past on the wet road.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
